scope: Exact integrated source and all four source-bound native artifacts. The older b2/a4 primary series remains separate pilot evidence and is never pooled.
hypothesis: Linux-only branch-summary CLI routing improves the primary Windows-GUI/WSL branch interactions. Existing Windows native policy and GUI behavior remain unchanged.
serial_execution: Run the Windows two-cell caller, then each Linux --case caller separately. No builds, tests, profilers, other benchmark or parallel resource work during scoring.
measurement: Original canonical welcome async-error readiness, measured Open, six actions, exact native Git/content/comment correctness and two completion frames. Default renderer. Existing two-comment profiles are reused; no copies, seeding, prewarming, helper preparation or cache flush.
baseline_identity: A remains exact b2/source56a8. Integrated base ce75 differs in current tests only; full source identities stay distinct. New B is ce75 plus only the Linux branch-filter condition and preserves all current tests.

qualification.correctness: Every source/build/producer/fixture/native-content/comment/identity/cleanup gate must pass. Invalid runs stop without automatic measurement retries.
qualification.primary_gain: Windows GUI/WSL maximum final20 p95 across branch_first, branch_final, stack and comment_branch must improve by at least10% against its new matched A series. A1 Open alone cannot establish a gain.
qualification.same_side_guards: For windows_windows and wsl_linux, every action final20 median and p95 and fresh-process Open median and p95 must be at most110% of matching A.
qualification.cross_guards: For windows_linux and reversed wsl_windows, every action final20 p95 and fresh-process Open p95 must be at most110% of matching A while the primary branch gain passes. No global worst-latency improvement is required in unaffected controls.
qualification.maximums_and_first_use: Retain all fresh Opens and first-use values, full20 p50/p95/max, strict repeated19 and all-series maxima. Investigate max outliers; do not introduce a new hard maximum gate for this expansion.
qualification.decision: This protocol qualifies an optimization for further delivery verification. It does not complete the full goal merely because partial gains pass. Keep failed or inconclusive evidence without waivers.

full_goal: Every cross-cell opening and interaction p95 below250ms, representative first/cold behavior, exact delivered source/builds and correctness must still be verified. Fresh processes are not OS-cold. No contract or charter has been weakened.
